Condition Description: Elevated body temperature often caused by infections (viral, bacterial, or parasitic).
Recommended Action: Monitor temperature, rest, hydrate. Seek help if fever persists beyond 3 days.

Condition Description: Discomfort in chest, possibly due to cardiovascular or stress-related issues.
Recommended Action: Seek immediate medical attention if pain is severe or radiates.

Condition Description: Pain in the head due to stress, fatigue, or neurological causes.
Recommended Action: Rest in a dark room, avoid triggers, take prescribed meds.

Condition Description: Breathing difficulty due to respiratory or viral conditions.
Recommended Action: Use inhalers if prescribed. Seek urgent care if worsening.

Condition Description: Pain in the abdomen caused by digestive issues or inflammation.
Recommended Action: Avoid spicy food. Visit ER if vomiting or pain intensifies.

Condition Description: Lower back discomfort from posture issues or disc displacement.
Recommended Action: Rest, apply heat, consider physiotherapy.

Condition Description: Red, itchy patches from allergens or chronic skin disorders.
Recommended Action: Apply creams, avoid allergens.

Condition Description: Increased urination due to infection or elevated blood glucose.
Recommended Action: Drink fluids, seek medical care if persistent.

Condition Description: Persistent tiredness from hormonal or blood-related disorders.
Recommended Action: Rest, eat well, take prescribed supplements or meds.

Condition Description: Vision issues due to high eye pressure or diabetes.
Recommended Action: See ophthalmologist immediately to avoid long-term damage.

Condition Description: A feeling of spinning or loss of balance due to inner ear or circulatory issues.
Recommended Action: Sit or lie down, avoid sudden movements.

Condition Description: Pain in joints due to inflammation or autoimmune causes.
Recommended Action: Use anti-inflammatory meds, physical therapy.

Condition Description: Rapid or irregular heartbeats due to heart rhythm issues or stress.
Recommended Action: Avoid caffeine/stimulants. Follow up with cardiologist.

Condition Description: Stomach discomfort leading to vomiting, often from infections or toxins.
Recommended Action: Rehydrate with ORS. Avoid solid food temporarily.

Condition Description: Reflex to clear airways, either from infections or irritants.
Recommended Action: Use cough syrup or inhalers as prescribed.

Condition Description: Fluid accumulation or clotting leading to swelling.
Recommended Action: Elevate legs, seek immediate attention for sudden swelling.

Condition Description: Excessive sweating at night often due to infections or hormonal issues.
Recommended Action: Maintain hygiene, visit doctor for TB or thyroid check.

Condition Description: Significant weight reduction without dieting, may indicate serious illness.
Recommended Action: Track food intake, get thorough checkup.

Condition Description: Reduced desire to eat due to mental health or organ issues.
Recommended Action: Small frequent meals, consider counseling or treatment.

Condition Description: Difficulty remembering due to neurological or nutritional issues.
Recommended Action: Include B12-rich food, mental exercises, consult specialist.
